# Provider Artifact Corpus

This corpus supplies representative provider-native files for discovery, stage,
commit, and diagnostics tests. Each fixture is rooted at one selected project.

The corpus must contain only public, synthetic content. Add a fixture when a
registry definition declares a new project artifact class, and cover its
discovery behavior plus any fixed canonical scope.

Do not place provider-home data, credentials, real project guidance, or a
second project tree in this corpus.
